note: BOOK BACK MATTER, NOT CHAPTER 14 CONTENT. Printed page 522, the third page of the book's INDEX: two columns of alphabetical index entries with page references. An index is publishing furniture / back matter and must not be used as chapter-14 passage text; transcribed only because the A2 schema rejects a zero-block page and so the page-coverage check can see the page was accounted for. previous_page_last_block was null, so continuation was judged from my own p053 output, whose alphabetical run ended at 'H.A. Lorentz 134'; this page resumes the same list at 'Half life', so first_block_continues_from_previous is true. Reading order is left column then right column, which is also the order the text layer uses: block n=1 is the left column (Half life ... field lines 175) and block n=2 the right column (field on the axis of a circular current loop 145 ... winter 457). The column break falls inside the 'Magnetic' head-word's run of indented sub-entries, so the right column opens with more of that group. Two-reference entries ('flux 182, 206') are kept as printed, and in the one entry whose label and page number share a text-layer line ('field on the axis of a circular current loop 145') that line is kept as printed. The index runs on to the next page, so the last block is marked continues_on_next and last_block_continues_on_next is true. No equations, tables or figures on this page.
